entries.note: PR #4372 round 1: independent audit of the one new key tui.chrome.remote_park.ask_agent_started (commit b1550a814) against en 8d3cce5ad16b with context sidecar f34bf588287f (meaning: an agent running on {agent_device} started the session, which runs on {device}; agent = AI agent). Mechanical: key set equals en; placeholders {agent_device} and {device} preserved exactly; NFC; no format/bidi control characters; no final punctuation, matching en. Semantic: 'Câu hỏi từ một phiên do tác nhân trên {agent_device} khởi chạy trên {device}': 'do X khởi chạy' is the idiomatic agentive passive; glossary phiên/tác nhân; 'trên {device}' as in 'chạy trên {device}'. Carry-forward: the other 15 keys are byte-identical — removing the new key from current en, the en context sidecar and this locale and re-serialising reproduces the base 1a8dae591 bytes exactly, and those base file hashes equal the previous receipt's source/context/target hashes — so that audit carries onto the new en hash.
